q: Which box-sizing value makes width and height include the padding and border?
explain: With border-box, the width and height include content, padding, and border, but not the margin.
hook: border-box: the border is in the box.

sources.title: box-sizing CSS property - CSS | MDN
sources.quote: The width and height properties include the content, padding, and border, but do not include the margin. Note that padding and border will be inside of the box.

sources.title: box-sizing CSS property - CSS | MDN
sources.quote: border-box tells the browser to account for any border and padding in the values you specify for an element's width and height.

q: Which EventTarget method sets up a function to be called whenever a specified event is delivered to the target?
explain: addEventListener() adds a function to the list of event listeners for the given event type, e.g. el.addEventListener("click", modifyText).
hook: add an ear (listener) to the element.

sources.title: EventTarget: addEventListener() method - Web APIs | MDN
sources.quote: The addEventListener() method of the EventTarget interface sets up a function that will be called whenever the specified event is delivered to the target.

q: Along which axis does justify-content align flex items?
explain: justify-content aligns items on the main axis, the direction set by flex-direction; align-items aligns them on the cross axis.

sources.title: Basic concepts of flexbox - CSS | MDN
sources.quote: The justify-content property is used to align the items on the main axis, the direction in which flex-direction has set the flow.

sources.title: Basic concepts of flexbox - CSS | MDN
sources.quote: The align-items property aligns all the flex items on the cross axis.

q: What does Object.keys() return for an object?
explain: It returns the object's own enumerable string-keyed property names, e.g. ["a", "b", "c"].

sources.title: Object.keys() - JavaScript | MDN
sources.quote: The Object.keys() static method returns an array of a given object's own enumerable string-keyed property names.
